claims.text: The NUS outperformed the ABUS with a success rate of 93.4% and average reward of 13.8, compared to the ABUS's 90.0% success rate and 13.3 average reward.
In cross-model evaluation, NUS policies achieved a success rate of 94.0% when tested on ABUS, while ABUS policies had a success rate of 45.5% when tested on NUS.
